name: apply_eq_of_dist_lt
statement: ∀ n, E n} {n : ℕ} (h : dist x y < (1 / 2) ^ n) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) : x i = y i

name: exists_disjoint_cylinder
statement: Set (∀ n, E n)} (hs : IsClosed s) {x : ∀ n, E n} (hx : x ∉ s) : ∃ n, Disjoint s (cylinder x n)

name: firstDiff_lt_shortestPrefixDiff
statement: Set (∀ n, E n)} (hs : IsClosed s) {x y : ∀ n, E n} (hx : x ∉ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : firstDiff x y < shortestPrefixDiff x s

name: inter_cylinder_longestPrefix_nonempty
statement: Set (∀ n, E n)} (hs : IsClosed s) (hne : s.Nonempty) (x : ∀ n, E n) : (s ∩ cylinder x (longestPrefix x s)).Nonempty

have_tree.name: B
have_tree.type: longestPrefix x s < shortestPrefixDiff x s

name: cylinder_longestPrefix_eq_of_longestPrefix_lt_firstDiff
statement: ∀ n, E n} {s : Set (∀ n, E n)} (hs : IsClosed s) (hne : s.Nonempty) (H : longestPrefix x s < firstDiff x y) (xs : x ∉ s) (ys : y ∉ s) : cylinder x (longestPrefix x s) = cylinder y (longestPrefix y s)

name: exists_lipschitz_retraction_of_isClosed
statement: Set (∀ n, E n)} (hs : IsClosed s) (hne : s.Nonempty) : ∃ f : (∀ n, E n) → ∀ n, E n, (∀ x ∈ s, f x = x) ∧ range f = s ∧ LipschitzWith 1 f

name: exists_nat_nat_continuous_surjective_of_completeSpace
statement: Type*) [MetricSpace α] [CompleteSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α] [Nonempty α] : ∃ f : (ℕ → ℕ) → α, Continuous f ∧ Surjective f

name: separation
statement: X} {C : Set X} (hxC : C ∈ 𝓝 x) : ∃ (n : ℕ), C ∈ (𝓝 (distDenseSeq X n x)).comap (distDenseSeq X n)

children.type: dist x y < infDist x (closure Cᶜ)
